pathAssistantSteps.info:
• Candidate has accepted the offer and completed joining formalities.
  • Trigger background check.
  • Verify if Work Order is created for the same candidate.
  • Once set to Hired, status cannot be changed.

• Schedule interviews in the calendar and confirm with the candidate.
  • Capture feedback consistently.
  • Track and Keep the status updated after each round.
  • If cleared → move to Offered, else → Rejected.

• Candidate record is created with this status.
  • Confirm candidate details and ensure the correct job position is linked.
  • Move to Shortlisted once reviewed.

• Candidate has cleared interviews and is extended a job offer.
  • Send an official offer letter.
  • Track candidate acceptance or negotiation.
  • Communicate clearly with both HR & the hiring manager.
  • If accepted → move to Hired, if declined → Rejected.

• Candidate is not moving forward in the hiring process.
  • Record a clear reason for rejection (e.g., Skills mismatch, Salary expectations, etc.).
  • Notify the candidate politely.
  • Keep a record for future opportunities.
  • Once set to Rejected, status cannot be changed.

• Candidate has been selected for further process.
  • Ensure the candidate meets baseline requirements.
  • Keep the candidate informed about next steps.
  • Move to Screening when ready.
